name: Standing Roll Down
summary: Standing tall, roll the spine down towards the floor one segment at a time and roll back up.
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width, knees soft.
Breathe out to nod the chin and roll down one bone at a time, arms hanging.
Breathe out to roll up from the tail, head last.

layers.title: Against a wall
layers.text: Peel away from the wall and back.

layers.title: Hands by the shoulders
layers.text: Elbows wide for more upper-back load.

cautions.note: Forward flexion; keep it small or hinge with a flat back.

cues:
Weight stays over the middle of the feet.
Let the head and arms hang.
Stack up from the bottom.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
